fishing: WHEN: early/moving tides. PASSES-BEACH: snook C&R, redfish, jacks Stump/Manasota. LEMON BAY: redfish schools, snook docks/shore, trout. NEARSHORE: mangrove/lane snapper, gag grouper. Baits: live shrimp, pinfish, threadfin, soft plastics.
redtide: FWC: K. brevis not observed statewide past week.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD (~20 CFU); Charlotte sites clear.
